title: Kissed Herbal French Rice Souffle
description: A fragrant, low-glycemic one-pot souffle with puff pastry topping, blending carnaroli rice and delicate herbs for a gooey finish.
instructions: Preheat oven to 200C and line a baking dish with parchment paper.
In a saucepan, heat vegetable broth with thyme, rosemary, and lavender until it simmers, then set aside.
In a heavy-bottomed pot, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat; add rice and stir for 2 minutes until toasted.
Gradually whisk in the hot broth, cover, and simmer for 18 minutes until rice is al dente, stirring occasionally.
Remove pot from heat and whisk in egg yolks, parmesan, salt, and pepper until the mixture thickens.
Whisk egg whites separately until soft peaks form, then fold them into the rice mixture gently to aerate.
Spread the souffle mixture into the prepared baking dish, smoothing the top with a spatula.
Cut puff pastry into thin strips and lay them over the souffle surface in a crisscross pattern for lamination puff.
Bake for 15 minutes until the puff pastry is golden and the souffle rises.
Allow to rest 5 minutes, then serve warm.
